# 环境变量 / Environment variables

<!-- Generated by horosa-skill/scripts/gen_env_reference.py from config.ENV_FLAG_REGISTRY + env_docs.ENV_FLAG_DOCS. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every `HOROSA_*` variable the skill knows (90). An unknown `HOROSA_*` name is warned about once and
ignored (`HOROSA_STRICT_CONFIG=1` makes it an error). A value that cannot be parsed falls back to the default and
`doctor` names it (`env:rejected_value`, provenance `default:rejected env:<NAME>=…`); a service URL without
`http://` is kept but flagged (`env:invalid_url`). Values of names that look like keys or tokens are never printed.

本工具认得的全部 `HOROSA_*` 变量。未知名字告警一次并忽略；认不出的值回落默认值，`doctor` 会点名；密钥 / 令牌类的值永不回显。

## Stable — documented, for users / 稳定：给用户用的

| Variable | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `HOROSA_ASTRODATA_DB` | Path to an alternative celebrity birth-data database for horosa_astro_astrodata. |
| `HOROSA_CHART_SERVER_ROOT` | Python chart service URL; the pair to HOROSA_SERVER_ROOT. Must be a full http(s):// URL. |
| `HOROSA_CLARIFY` | Clarification gate level for missing result-changing settings (`never` turns the gate off; for testing only). |
| `HOROSA_EMBED_MODEL_DIR` | Folder holding the embedding model files for vector search on an offline machine. |
| `HOROSA_INSTALL_CONTEXT` | Set by a host (`plugin` / `mcpb`) so recovery commands are printed in the form that works there. |
| `HOROSA_JS_ENGINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Wall-clock limit for one JS-engine call (default 60 s; long election searches raise it for themselves). |
| `HOROSA_KNOWLEDGE_VECTORS` | `0` = turn off the optional vector search over your notes (plain BM25 only). |
| `HOROSA_LOCAL_BACKEND_PORT` | Port the managed Java backend listens on (default 9999). HOROSA_SERVER_ROOT follows it unless set. |
| `HOROSA_LOCAL_CHART_PORT` | Port the managed chart service listens on (default 8899). HOROSA_CHART_SERVER_ROOT follows it unless set. |
| `HOROSA_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | Extra Host header values (comma-separated) the HTTP transport accepts. |
| `HOROSA_MCP_COMPACT` | `1` = expose the 14 facade tools instead of every technique tool. |
| `HOROSA_MCP_ELICIT` | `0` = never ask the user through MCP elicitation forms; missing settings come back as a structured refusal instead. |
| `HOROSA_MCP_ELICIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | How long an elicitation form waits for the user (default 120 s). |
| `HOROSA_MCP_MAX_CONCURRENT_TOOLS` | Most technique calls one MCP server runs at once (default 4). |
| `HOROSA_MCP_RESULT_MAX_CHARS` | Character budget for one MCP result in the reading view (default 48000, 4000–2000000; Claude Code spills results over 50000 characters to a file). |
| `HOROSA_MCP_RESULT_MAX_TOKENS` | Estimated-token budget for one MCP result in the reading view (default 20000, 2000–1000000); longer text is cut by whole sections with a follow-up call in `warnings`. |
| `HOROSA_MCP_RESULT_VIEW` | Default shape of MCP tool results: `reading` (default: reader text, section index, technique card, run id), `sections`, `titles`, or `full` (alias `raw`: the whole engine tree). A per-call `response_view` overrides it. |
| `HOROSA_MCP_TOKEN` | Bearer token required by `serve --transport streamable-http`. Never printed. |
| `HOROSA_NODE_BIN` | Node executable for the local JS engine (default: the runtime's bundled node, else node on PATH). Must exist and be >= 20.10. |
| `HOROSA_OUTPUT_SCHEMA` | `1` = advertise outputSchema and return structuredContent on MCP tools. |
| `HOROSA_OUTPUT_SCRIPT` | Result text script: zh-Hans (default), zh-Hant (Taiwan forms) or zh-Hant-HK (Hong Kong forms). |
| `HOROSA_PLUGIN_ROOT` | Set by a host together with HOROSA_INSTALL_CONTEXT: the directory the server was launched from. |
| `HOROSA_PORTS` | `auto` = pick a free port pair when the defaults are taken (for example by the Horosa desktop app). |
| `HOROSA_REPORT_OUTPUT_ROOTS` | Extra directories (os.pathsep-separated) a report's output_path may write into; the output directory is always allowed. |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_CALL_WAIT_SECONDS` | How long one tool call waits for a starting runtime before answering `runtime.starting` (default 5 s). |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_DOWNLOAD_ATTEMPTS` | Retries per download source when no progress is made (default 3, 1-20). |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Read timeout between 1 MiB chunks of the runtime download (default 120 s). |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_JAVA_RETRY_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` | After the Java backend failed to start, how long Java-side calls fail fast before a retry (default 120 s, 0 = off). |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_MANIFEST_URL` | Release manifest to install from (default: the latest GitHub release). A manifest without sha256 is refused for network downloads. |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_MIRROR` | Comma-separated URL prefixes that replace https://github.com for the manifest, the runtime archive and the wheel; the original URL is always tried last. |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_PLATFORM` | Force the payload platform key (darwin-arm64 / win32-x64) instead of detecting it. |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_RELEASE_REPO` | GitHub owner/repo the default manifest URL points at. |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_ROOT` | Offline runtime directory (default ~/.horosa/runtime; %LOCALAPPDATA%\Horosa\runtime on Windows). On Windows it must be ASCII-only. |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_START_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | How long a cold start may take before `runtime.start_timeout` (default 45 s, 120 s on emulated hosts). |
| `HOROSA_SERVER_ROOT` | Java backend URL. Set it (with HOROSA_CHART_SERVER_ROOT) to use an engine elsewhere — gateway / external mode; nothing is started locally. Must be a full http(s):// URL. |
| `HOROSA_SKILL_DATA_DIR` | Data directory: memory.db, runs, traces, profiles, knowledge (default ~/.horosa-skill; %APPDATA%\HorosaSkill on Windows). |
| `HOROSA_SKILL_DB_PATH` | Memory database file (default <data dir>/memory.db). |
| `HOROSA_SKILL_HOST` | Bind address of the HTTP server (default 127.0.0.1). |
| `HOROSA_SKILL_LOG_LEVEL` | Log level (default INFO). |
| `HOROSA_SKILL_OUTPUT_DIR` | Where run artifacts and reports go (default <data dir>/runs). |
| `HOROSA_SKILL_PORT` | Port of the HTTP server (default 8765). |
| `HOROSA_STRICT_CONFIG` | `1` = an unknown HOROSA_* variable is an error instead of a warning. |
| `HOROSA_TECHNIQUE_CARD` | `0` = leave the technique card out of results. |
| `HOROSA_TOOLSETS` | Comma-separated technique groups to expose (for example `astro,cn`). |
| `HOROSA_TRACE_CAPTURE_AI_ANSWERS` | `1` = include recorded AI answers in traces. |
| `HOROSA_TRACE_CAPTURE_PAYLOADS` | `1` = include request payloads in traces. |
| `HOROSA_TRACE_DIR` | Where traces go (default <data dir>/traces). |
| `HOROSA_TRACE_ENABLED` | `0` = do not write local traces. |
| `HOROSA_TRACE_OTLP_ENDPOINT` | OTLP endpoint to export traces to (off by default; nothing leaves the machine unless set). |
| `HOROSA_USER_KNOWLEDGE_DIR` | Your own knowledge-notes folder (default <data dir>/knowledge). |
| `HOROSA_USER_KNOWLEDGE_MAX_CHARS` | Most characters of your notes carried into one computation (default 12000, 500-200000). |

## Experimental — may change / 试验：可能会变

| Variable | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `HOROSA_CDS_TRAIN_PORT` | Port of the one-off AppCDS training JVM on first start (upstream hard-codes 39997); change it if that port is taken. |
| `HOROSA_CORE_JS_ROOT` | A horosa-core-js directory to use before the runtime's copy and the `install --engine-only` asset (the Docker image sets it). |
| `HOROSA_JEV` | Optional TypeSafe Jev decision layer: `off` (default), `shadow` or `enforce`. |
| `HOROSA_JEV_API_KEY` | API key for the decision layer. Never printed. |
| `HOROSA_JEV_BASE_URL` | Decision-layer API base URL. |
| `HOROSA_JEV_LEDGER` | `0` = do not keep the local decision ledger. |
| `HOROSA_JEV_MODEL` | Pinned decision-layer model version. |
| `HOROSA_JEV_SCOPE` | What the decision layer may send: `meta` (default, redacted question text) or `snapshot`. |
| `HOROSA_JEV_SURFACES` | Which decisions it may make (comma-separated; default dispatch,extract,zhancat). |
| `HOROSA_JEV_TIMEOUT_MS` | Per-request timeout of the decision layer in ms (default from decisions/policy.py, 200-30000). |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_LAUNCHER_PATCH` | `0` = skip the macOS launcher patch that limits the stop script to processes this tool started (you lose that guard). |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_TRUST_PORTS` | `1` = treat an unidentified service already on the ports as the Horosa backend instead of refusing to use it. |

## Internal — build machines, scripts, launcher plumbing; normally not set by hand / 内部：构建机、脚本、启动器机务，一般不手设

| Variable | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `HOROSA_APP_CHARTS` | `0` = draw report figures with the skill's own renderer only (troubleshooting). |
| `HOROSA_APP_CHARTS_DEBUG` | Maintainer build switch: build an unminified app-charts bundle. |
| `HOROSA_BACKEND_PORT` | Launcher-internal port variable read by start scripts. |
| `HOROSA_CHART_PORT` | Launcher-internal: chart port handed to the start scripts. Use HOROSA_LOCAL_CHART_PORT instead. |
| `HOROSA_DESKTOP_MONGO_OPTIONAL` | Launcher-to-engine knob: run the Java backend without MongoDB. |
| `HOROSA_DESKTOP_MONGO_SKIP_PING` | Launcher-to-engine knob: skip the MongoDB ping at start. |
| `HOROSA_ENABLE_STARTUP_CRON` | Launcher-to-engine knob: enable the upstream startup cron jobs. |
| `HOROSA_ENABLE_STARTUP_TRANSGROUP_INIT` | Launcher-to-engine knob: enable the upstream transgroup init at start. |
| `HOROSA_EPHE_PATH_FASTPATH` | Launcher-to-engine knob: the Windows start script sets it to 0 before starting the chart service. |
| `HOROSA_JAVA_HOME` | Desktop-app build scripts: JDK path (often set on machines that build the desktop app). |
| `HOROSA_JEV_LIVE` | Test switch: `1` runs the live decision-layer smoke test. |
| `HOROSA_LAUNCH_NONCE` | Launcher-internal: proves a running service was started by this runtime root. |
| `HOROSA_LINUX_JAVA_HOME` | Payload build scripts: JDK to bundle for a Linux build. |
| `HOROSA_LINUX_PYTHON_HOME` | Payload build scripts: Python to bundle for a Linux build. |
| `HOROSA_LINUX_SKIP_DOWNLOAD` | Payload build scripts: skip downloading Linux toolchains. |
| `HOROSA_LOG_ROOT` | Launcher-internal: where the Windows start script writes its logs. |
| `HOROSA_MCPORTER_BIN` | Explicit mcporter executable (OpenClaw checks). |
| `HOROSA_MONGO_FALLBACK_DIR` | Launcher-to-engine knob: JSON files used instead of MongoDB. |
| `HOROSA_ROOT` | Launcher-internal: payload root handed to the start scripts. |
| `HOROSA_RUNTIME_RELEASE_BASE_URL` | Release scripts: base URL written into a generated runtime manifest. |
| `HOROSA_SERVER_PORT` | Launcher-internal: backend port handed to the start scripts. Use HOROSA_LOCAL_BACKEND_PORT instead. |
| `HOROSA_SKILL_PYPROJECT` | Release scripts: pyproject.toml to read the version from. |
| `HOROSA_SOURCE_ROOT` | Maintainer scripts: path of the upstream Horosa-Public checkout used for vendoring and gates. |
| `HOROSA_UVX_BIN` | Explicit uvx executable when it is not on PATH. |
| `HOROSA_UV_BIN` | Explicit uv executable when it is not on PATH. |
| `HOROSA_VERAPDF` | Test switch: veraPDF executable for the PDF/UA validation test. |
| `HOROSA_WINDOWS_SOURCE_ROOT` | Maintainer scripts: Windows build source tree for payload sync. |
